subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace product narrative & entitlements review
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nate Hsu <nate@signalflow.io>
Cc: productops@signalflow.io
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: AWS Marketplace product narrative & entitlements review

Hi all —

Attaching a cleaned-up draft of the product narrative and an entitlement matrix for the SignalFlow listing. High level asks below; please review the doc and matrix and reply with any redlines or missing entitlements by EOD tomorrow so we can hit the private offer window next week.

Quick context:
- Goal: Launch SignalFlow Managed Inference on AWS Marketplace (metered SaaS) + co-sell enablement.
- Primary asks for AWS listing: one-liner, 2–3 benefit bullets, SKU/entitlement mapping, technical AMI/AMI-visibility notes for AMI-backed private offers.

Review checklist (please comment inline or reply):
1) Narrative: Clear customer value (latency/cost wins) + callout for dedicated/private options.
2) Benefits: No claims about SOC scope beyond what we have — avoid "enterprise-grade SOC" phrasing.
3) Entitlements matrix: Verify mappings for metered features (concurrent jobs, token-hours, model variants).
4) Pricing visibility: Confirm which usage tiers are public vs only on private offers.
5) Co-sell assets: Ensure we have a 1-slide co-sell one-pager and AWS partner links.

Attachments: rw_product_onepager_v2.pdf, aws_entitlement_matrix.xlsx, ami-screenshot-landing.png

Nate — I left a few items highlighted for your team (billing meter names and acceptable SKU labels). Vanessa/Karthik/Marissa — can you each pick one section to own and reply with proposed edits?

Thanks,
Sooj

--
Soojin Lee
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Nate Hsu <nate@signalflow.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: productops@signalflow.io, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace product narrative & entitlements review

Thanks Soojin — nice clean draft. A few quick notes from SignalFlow side inline and summarized here: 

- Metering names: we prefer "concurrent-streams" rather than "concurrent-jobs" to match our billing API.
- Public tiers: we want only the base "Starter" and "Business" tiers public; "Enterprise (BYO-VPC)" should be via private offer only due to networking requirements.
- AMI note: the AMI screenshot is fine but please include the Seller ID I listed in the doc for private offers: 012345678901.
- Co-sell slide: attached one small change (slide 1 headline) — keep it short: "Reduce inference cost by 3–5x at scale" (we can include benchmark footnote).

Also flagging a procurement nuance: SignalFlow's procurement requires a 60-day auto-renew opt-out window in the PO. I'll share the procurement contact if you need to pre-seed DocuSign.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 23 Mar 2027 at 09:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:

Appended: rw_product_onepager_feedback.pdf (annotated), updated_meter_names.csv

Cheers,
Nate Hsu
Head of Product Ops, SignalFlow Inc.
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nate Hsu <nate@signalflow.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: AWS Marketplace product narrative & entitlements review

Thanks Nate — good catches. Per ownership: I'll take the Narrative + Benefits bullets and update tone to avoid overclaiming on compliance. Karthik — can you confirm seller ID inclusion and SKU naming convention? Marissa — can you take the entitlements matrix and map to our AWS SKU schema?

Decisions during review: 
- Narrative: change "SOC" phrasing to "SOC 2 controls in place" (no enterprise-grade).
- Pricing: Public listing will show Starter (monthly) and Business (metered) tiers. Enterprise pricing will be available via Private Offer only.
- Meter names: adopt SignalFlow's preferred label "concurrent-streams" in the matrix; map that to our internal meter ID SF-CONC-01.
- AMI/Seller ID: Karthik to confirm final seller ID to embed in AMI metadata.

I'll attach an updated one-pager (light edits) and a marked-up entitlement matrix by EOD — sending now.

Best,
Vanessa
Director, Partner Marketing, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Quick legal/ops confirmation:
- Seller ID: confirmed as 012345678901 (matches SignalFlow doc). I'll add that to the AMI metadata and private-offer checklist.
- SKU naming: we'll use pattern SF-<FEATURE>-<TIER> (example: SF-CONC-01-BUSINESS). Avoid special characters; underscores allowed only for internal meter IDs.
- Terms: Note the procurement ask (60-day auto-renew opt-out) — from a Redwood/marketplace perspective we can accept on the private offer PO but need procurement to approve. Looping in legal if PO deviates from standard.

Marking this thread resolved for marketplace copy. If there are any further edits after SignalFlow's final review, please flag and we can do a short follow-up.

Thanks — Karthik
